Game Overview

In Pixel Santa Jump, the core idea is straightforward: leap with joy as Santa hops skyward, collecting scattered gifts while avoiding perilous platforms in this delightful arcade adventure. Test your reflexes and aim for the heights, racking up scores with each festive present you snag. How high can you help Santa soar?
